name: Claims adjudication and batch denials
blurb: Post-service claim review by algorithm, where a system flags claims as not matching a diagnosis or coverage rule and a reviewer signs off on many at once.

points.desc: A proposed class action in the Eastern District of California alleges Cigna's PxDx system rejected claims in batches without a physician reviewing each file, in breach of California's requirement for a thorough, fair and objective investigation. Tracked live on this site.
points.name: The Cigna PxDx case

points.desc: Most state insurance codes require that a medical necessity denial be made by a qualified clinician and that the insurer investigate each claim; the question the batch cases test is whether seconds per file is an investigation at all.
points.name: What state law usually requires

summary: Post-service claim review by algorithm, where a system flags claims as not matching a diagnosis or coverage rule and a reviewer signs off on many at once.
